schema.text: When you cross the street on foot, do you feel rushed or unsure?

ar.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: عندما تعبر الشارع مشيًا، هل تشعر بالاستعجال أو بعدم الثقة؟

de.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: Fühlen Sie sich beim Überqueren der Straße zu Fuß gehetzt oder unsicher?

en.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: When you cross the street on foot, do you feel rushed or unsure?

fa.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: آیا وقتی پیاده از خیابان عبور می‌کنید، احساس عجله یا تردید می‌کنید؟

fr.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: Quand vous traversez la rue à pied, avez-vous l’impression de devoir vous dépêcher, ou ressentez-vous de l’incertitude ?

hu.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: Amikor gyalog átkel az úttesten, úgy érzi, sietnie kell, vagy bizonytalan?

it.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: Quando attraversi la strada a piedi, ti capita di sentirti sotto pressione o nell'incertezza?

tr.#When you cross the street on foot, do y: Yaya olarak karşıdan karşıya geçerken kendinizi aceleye gelmiş ya da tedirgin hissediyor musunuz?
